probe_detail.name: Names the concrete new development that makes this news today
Centers a person with an emotionally legible stake

final.name: Explainer-question format
final.audit_justification: Question framing is a template choice, though it can arise from genuinely informative explainer content.

final.name: HEADLINE
final.audit_justification: Foreign-place density is a geographic subject-matter marker rather than evidence of substantive headline quality.

final.name: Running-story stage cue
final.audit_justification: Continuation and closure words primarily reveal the temporal stage of a running story.
final.upstream_parent: Position within a multi-day running story

final.name: Explanatory promise
final.audit_justification: A credible promise to explain causes or mechanisms describes the substantive information offered to readers.

final.name: Opinion clash
final.audit_justification: Presenting identifiable competing positions communicates a substantive conflict that readers may genuinely value.

final.name: Visual imaginability
final.audit_justification: A concretely imaginable scene is a meaningful property of how intelligibly and compellingly the event is communicated.

final.name: Format or Service Promise
final.audit_justification: Maps, video, and live-coverage labels are presentation-package cues, though they may accompany genuinely useful reporting resources.
final.arbiter_reason: Promising specific formats like maps, live coverage, or videos provides a tangible material value to the reader that directly drives engagement. A judge scoring this evaluates the advertised informative substance of the article, which aligns with what makes readers click.

final.name: Practical Actionability
final.audit_justification: Advice, warnings, and decision support provide substantive practical value to readers.

final.name: Linguistic Accessibility
final.audit_justification: Clear vocabulary and syntax directly affect whether readers can understand the headline's substance.

final.name: Calendar-cycle wording
final.audit_justification: Holiday, season, and observance references are calendar-cycle and topic markers.

final.name: Distant Historical Discoveries
final.audit_justification: Historical discoveries constitute a subject-matter category rather than a general measure of informative quality.
final.arbiter_reason: This instruction routes on a pure topic marker rather than any inherent quality or execution of the news. Selecting for archaeology subjects measures an editorial category that travels with the item, not general evidence of what makes a headline clickable.

final.name: Domestic US political chaos
final.audit_justification: US political conflict is a narrowly defined topic marker rather than evidence about the headline's substantive execution.
final.arbiter_reason: Scoring the presence of US political conflict strictly identifies a high-drama subject matter category. It is a narrowly defined topic marker rather than a measure of a headline's intrinsic craftsmanship or substantive appeal.

final.name: Quoted Human Voice
final.audit_justification: When assessed for vivid human testimony rather than punctuation alone, a quoted voice supplies meaningful substantive perspective.

final.name: Confrontational cross-domain row
final.audit_justification: The specified personalities, cross-domain pairing, and row vocabulary form a narrow topic-and-wording fingerprint.
final.upstream_parent: Viral social media aggregation desk monitoring

final.name: ENCAPSULATED DIRECT QUOTATION
final.audit_justification: Unattributed text enclosed in quotation marks is chiefly a quotation-format and dramatic-framing convention.
final.upstream_parent: EDITORIAL PACKAGING (teasing strategy or click-bait framing)

final.name: First-person direct quote
final.audit_justification: A first-person pronoun inside quotation marks is a stylistic pattern, though it can originate in substantively valuable personal testimony.
final.upstream_parent: Editorial commissioning of personalized human-interest features

final.name: Esoteric Condition Neologisms
final.audit_justification: Naming an obscure condition identifies a medical or scientific topic niche rather than general substantive quality.

final.name: Evidence Cue
final.audit_justification: Attributing claims to evidence or an accountable authority directly strengthens their evidentiary basis.

final.name: Surprise or incongruity
final.audit_justification: A genuinely unexpected relationship or outcome is substantive information about the event's novelty.

final.name: Bizarre novelty and human oddities
final.audit_justification: Rare conditions, strange talents, and peculiar animals define a sensational subject-matter category.
final.arbiter_reason: This criterion purely isolates a sensational subject-matter category of rare medical conditions and oddities. A judge scoring this merely sorts items by their weird topic rather than measuring any textual property that drives reader behavior.

final.name: Visual-package cue
final.audit_justification: Explicit visual-package wording reflects production and homepage presentation, though the associated package may add genuine informational value.

final.name: Personal Consequence
final.audit_justification: Explicit effects on readers' safety, health, rights, or daily lives communicate substantive personal relevance.

final.name: HEADLINE
final.audit_justification: Conspicuous numeric wording is a surface marker, although it can result from genuinely precise and informative reporting.

final.name: Explicit Information Gap
final.audit_justification: A meaningful promise to answer or explain something describes substantive information the item offers.

final.name: Internet-native cultural phenomenon or mystery
final.audit_justification: Viral trends, online mysteries, and bizarre online behavior form an internet-culture topic category.
final.arbiter_reason: Identifying viral trends and internet mysteries simply categorizes a niche topic area that currently captures audience attention. This acts as a temporal topic marker rather than a measure of a headline's structural or substantive quality.
